FIGURE FAR DOWN THE CHAMBER: one small figure far down the chamber holding a lantern, their back to us, tiny against the glowing ice walls
FIGURE ON THE ICE STAIR: a tiny figure on the ice stair with a lantern, turned away, the warm glow pooling soft and gold around small boots
FIGURE AT THE POOL'S EDGE: a small figure at a frozen pool's edge seen from behind, the still water reflecting their lantern twice over
FIGURE IN THE LONG COAT: a tiny figure far off in a long coat, back to us, looking up at a ceiling hung with pale crystalline spires
FIGURE NEAR THE TALL COLUMN: one small figure far across the chamber, lantern raised, turned away, tiny beside a towering pillar of blue ice
FIGURE ON THE FAR BRIDGE: a small figure at the centre of the ice bridge, back to us, lantern swinging gently, distant and very small in the frame
BIRDS ON THE HIGH LEDGE: a few small white birds dotted along a high ledge as tiny specks, easy to miss among the frost
BIRD ACROSS THE UPPER DARK: one small bird gliding across the upper dark of the chamber, a pale sliver against the deep blue ceiling
BIRDS IN THE HIGH CRACK: a pair of small birds nesting in a high crack, tiny and easy to miss, tucked warm behind a fringe of ice
BIRDS ON THE LONG ICICLE: three small birds far off perched along the longest icicle, tiny dots of white against the dripping crystal
BIRD ALONG THE FAR WALL: a single small bird settled on a distant ledge, a tiny white comma resting quietly in the far blue shadow
WHITE FOX ON THE LEDGE: a small white fox picking along a far ledge, tiny in the frame, pausing once to consider the gleaming floor below
HARE ON THE CHAMBER FLOOR: a small hare sitting still far down the floor, round and pale, a soft shape in the wide quiet of the ice
WEASEL AT THE FAR WALL: a little white weasel slipping along the base of the far wall, a quick bright thread disappearing into blue distance
ARCTIC FOX NEAR THE POOL: a small white fox paused far off at the edge of a still pool, tiny against the luminous ice, ears tipped forward
FISH FAR BELOW THE FLOOR: a few small silver fish tiny and far below the clear floor, catching the light as they drift through the deep blue
SEAL UNDER THE CLEAR FLOOR ICE: a small seal turning slowly far below the clear floor ice, a pale shape moving in long lazy loops through the still water
DARK SHAPE DEEP BELOW: a tiny dark shape swimming far below and away through the ice floor, small and unhurried, trailing a ribbon of silver bubbles
SHAPES IN THE DEEP ICE: a scattering of tiny silver forms far beneath the clear floor, drifting slow and small in the luminous pale green deep
TWO FIGURES ON THE BRIDGE: two small figures far out on the ice bridge, small and turned away, the arch of ice curving around them like a cradle
TWO FIGURES WITH ONE LANTERN: two tiny figures at the far end of the chamber with one lantern between them, backs to us, sharing its small warm light
TWO FIGURES BY THE COLUMN: two small figures far off beside a broad ice column, turned away together, tiny in the enormous pale blue of the room
ROUND BIRD BY THE LANTERN: a small round bird fluffed up on the warm stone beside a lantern, tiny and content, eyes half closed in the gentle heat
MOTH AT THE LANTERN GLASS: a pale moth turning slowly at the lantern glass, small wings catching the gold, circling in a patient dreamy loop
CAT ON THE WARM LEDGE: a small cat curled asleep on a warm ledge, small and far, a neat little crescent of fur tucked into the amber lantern glow
